original.verbatim:
I'll help you check and modify the payment method for your order. First, I need to authenticate your identity. Could you please provide your email address?

Also, to assist you better, I'll need:
1. The order ID number (starts with #W)
2. Details of the additional payment method you'd like to use

Please note that for pending orders, we can only use one payment method at a time - we cannot split the payment between multiple cards. I can help you switch to a different payment method entirely if that would be helpful.

Let me help you find your user information and order details using your email.

<antml:function_calls>
<antml:invoke name="find_user_id_by_email">
<antml:parameter name="email">daikisanchez1479@example.com</antml:parameter>
</antml:invoke>
</antml:function_calls>

I'll look up your account using your name and zip code.

<antml:function_calls>
<antml:invoke name="find_user_id_by_name_zip">
<antml:parameter name="first_name">Daiki</antml:parameter>
<antml:parameter name="last_name">Sanchez</antml:parameter>
<antml:parameter name="zip">46236</antml:parameter>
</antml:invoke>
</antml:function_calls>

I can see your recent order (#W9348897) which is still in pending status. The most expensive item in your order is the Action Camera at $481.50. Here's a breakdown of all items in your order:

1. Action Camera (4K, Silver) - $481.50
2. Patio Umbrella (6ft, Green) - $288.82
3. Backpack (Green, Small) - $193.38
4. Desk Lamp (Silver) - $150.01
5. T-Shirt (Black, XXL) - $53.27

Total order amount: $1,166.98

Since you mentioned your card has a $950 limit, and we cannot split payments between multiple cards, you have a few options:
1. Remove the Action Camera (most expensive item) to bring the total below $950
2. Switch the entire payment to a different payment method that has sufficient funds
3. Cancel the order and place a new one with the items you want to keep

Would you like to proceed with any of these options? Please let me know which you prefer and I'll help you with the next steps.

I apologize, but I need to clarify something - I am not able to remove individual items from an existing order. For a pending order, your options are:

1. Cancel the entire order and place a new order with just the items you want to keep
2. Keep all items but change the payment method to a different card with sufficient funds

If you'd like to proceed with cancelling the order (so you can place a new order without the Action Camera), I can help you with that. Would you like me to cancel order #W9348897? Please confirm with "yes" if you want to cancel the order, and let me know if the reason is "no longer needed" or "ordered by mistake".

I'll help you cancel the order #W9348897. Here are the details of what will happen:

- Order #W9348897 with total amount of $1,166.98 will be cancelled
- Since the payment was made with a credit card (ending in 6593), the refund will be processed to the same card within 5-7 business days
- After cancellation, you can place a new order with just the items you want to keep

Please confirm once more with "yes" that you want me to proceed with the cancellation.

<antml:function_calls>
<antml:invoke name="cancel_pending_order">
<antml:parameter name="order_id">#W9348897</antml:parameter>
<antml:parameter name="reason">ordered by mistake</antml:parameter>
</antml:invoke>
</antml:function_calls>
